- inscription: "You say what others soften, then quietly pay for being the one who did."
- dm_overview (the sign): [REDACTED: the target field]
- yourNature_desc (baseline, band-neutral): "You put the truth ahead of your own comfort, and usually ahead of your own company. People keep the clarity you hand them and stay careful around the edge it came from. The cost never comes up. You've never once shown anyone the bill."

### Pair cell 金_金 (door body, Core element Metal, energy element Metal. Law: Metal and Metal are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Metal is this core's Body.)
- function.definition_catalyst: "Metal is your Body, and running thin, it is the reserve everything else draws on: sleep, food, recovery, the physical base under your discipline. Yours holds form long after the fuel is low, so you notice depletion late."
- function.definition_friction: "Metal is your Body, and running over, it is more physical force than your life currently spends: discipline with no outlet, stamina turning into tension you carry in your shoulders and jaw."
- carry.wide: none (self pair): the Body wide gift is cut from this cell's definition_catalyst, echo_of = 金_金.function.definition_catalyst
- carry.excess: {"clause":"Strong metal wants water: so much certainty it cuts everything the same way.","remedy":"Let water blunt it. Say it, don't cut it."}

### Pair cell 金_土 (door mind, Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind.)
- function.definition_catalyst: "Earth is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is a slow, deep intake that turns experience into ground you can stand on. Books, mentors, quiet corners, long walks after hard conversations: whatever feeds it comes back later as judgment."
- function.definition_friction: "Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch. Study, comfort, preparation, shelter: everything that goes in counts as progress, so nothing ever has to come out. Learning becomes the most respectable way to stand still."
- carry.wide: {"clause":"You are well supplied with Earth, the ground the ore grows in.","remedy":"Use what the ground gave you. Cut something."}
- carry.excess: {"clause":"Too much earth clogs the metal: fed past use, the edge stalls, brooding where it should cut.","remedy":"Dig out. Less study, one real cut."}

### Pair cell 金_水 (door expression, Core element Metal, energy element Water. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Water is this core's Expression.)
- function.definition_catalyst: "Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the bright remark that turns an evening: whatever is inside you moves outward without forcing, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry."
- function.definition_friction: "Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output with no banks. Talent spills wherever it lands, into snacks and scrolling, into remarks that cut deeper than intended, into half-made things. Nothing is wrong, exactly. That is the problem. The spill keeps absorbing the effort your best work was waiting for."
- carry.wide: {"clause":"There is no shortage of Water in you, the channel that lets the blade breathe.","remedy":"Say it while it is fresh. Ship the draft."}
- carry.excess: {"clause":"Too much water sinks the metal: output floods the work, saying everything and shaping nothing.","remedy":"Cut the flow. Finish one thing in silence."}

### Pair cell 金_木 (door action, Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action.)
- function.definition_catalyst: "Wood is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is effort that behaves like a living thing. Whatever you plant and keep tending, money, skills, ventures, trust, grows on its own schedule and pays you back with interest, because your work compounds instead of burning off."
- function.definition_friction: "Wood is your Action, and as a friction, it is growth that stops answering to the harvest. Effort goes wherever the roots or the branches already point, old ground held too hard, new shoots started too freely, and the season ends with plenty of motion and nothing ripe."
- carry.wide: {"clause":"Wood is already here in plenty, the material the knife is for.","remedy":"Cut what is already in front of you. Finish it."}
- carry.excess: {"clause":"Hard wood chips the edge: more to cut than the metal can bear, effort dulling on what resists.","remedy":"Cut less. Sharpen before you cut."}

### Pair cell 金_火 (door order, Core element Metal, energy element Fire. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Fire is this core's Order.)
- function.definition_catalyst: "Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is structure with heat in it. Pressure organizes you instead of scattering you, rules turn into momentum, and when things fall apart you are the one holding a straight line through the middle of it."
- function.definition_friction: "Fire is your Order, and as a friction, it is order with the thermostat broken. Every rule runs hot, every moment gets treated like an emergency, and the structure that held things up presses down on people, then hardest on you. Nobody judges the edge as harshly as you do."
- carry.wide: {"clause":"Fire is easy for you to reach, the forge that finishes the edge.","remedy":"Take the pressure you have. Let it sharpen you."}
- carry.excess: {"clause":"Weak metal melts in strong fire: pressure past what the edge can hold, rules that soften, not shape.","remedy":"Step out of the fire. Add ground."}

dm_overview.value: The Blade is Metal in its yang form, the ore that went into the forge soft and came out with an edge. Its season is autumn, when the year stops growing things and starts choosing which of them to keep. Steel like this does one job. It cuts, once, and the cut stays cut. Left alone it wants nothing, asks nothing, and rusts only where it was never used. A sword hung over a doorway keeps the whole house honest without saying a word.
dm_overview._trace: yang Metal as forged ore, autumn as the season of deciding, the figure of the sword over the door

spec.notes: sentence 1 receives the sign paragraph's central image onto the reader in this stem's own words; the band is a present state, never a decline; no four-word run from another stem's portrait

band.yourNature_desc.value: You are that sword when it comes down off the doorway and walks around as a person. There's more edge in you than one life has things to cut, so the edge goes looking. The straight answer is out of you before anyone asked, at the kitchen table as easily as at work. Right is not the same as welcome. People keep what you told them and a little distance from the teller.
band.yourNature_desc._trace: the sign's sword received onto the reader, Overfueled as more edge than one life has things to cut, the cost paid in company

band.self_card.presence.value: Every day the edge is out. You don't decide to be honest, it's already done, and people learn where to stand.
band.self_card.presence.value_b: There is no sheath and there never was. What you see you say, and the few who stay close have stopped flinching.

value.desc: Pressure makes you simpler. When the plan collapses, the bill comes due or someone in the family gets bad news, the noise drops out and you know the next cut. The price is the quiet weeks, when nothing is on fire and you have to be a person anyway.

value.desc: Whatever you take care of grows while you're not looking. A skill kept up, a friend called back, money left alone, all of it comes back bigger than it went in, in its own time. The cost is that quick wins bore you, and you keep working a piece that stopped paying a while ago.

value.desc: What's in you comes out in plain words and small acts, no speech first. The true sentence, the fixed shelf, the meal nobody asked for, the call made first, and the person is fed before they knew they were hungry. Anyone who wanted it dressed up reads plain as cold, and that is what it costs you.
